observations.behavior: The resume snapshot implementation no longer branches between filesystem and directory snapshots; it unconditionally uses the directory-based approach.
observations.posthog_connection: This removes a legacy code path for full workspace snapshots. PostHog users benefit from this if their workflow relies on directory-resume capability rather than filesystem snapshots.

observations.behavior: All callers now invoke only `sandbox.create_directory_snapshot`, removing conditional branching based on input flags or error handling differences between snapshot types.
observations.posthog_connection: Simplifies execution and recovery behavior in task workflows. This could reduce configuration-dependent failure modes but does not demonstrate broader systemic improvement without wider context.

observations.behavior: Both resume-snapshot-related fields are hardcoded to True, while all feature-flag checks and compatibility parameters have been removed.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes runtime behavior by permanently enabling directory-resume snapshots regardless of user opt-in or organization settings. This is an operational change that may affect reliability or compatibility depending on downstream expectations.
